resources.string: Enabled metamodules: %1$d · System mount modules: %2$d · View dependencies
No system mount request; scripts may have other dependencies

System overlays need one compatible metamodule. This manager does not select or install one automatically. Removing, disabling or replacing it can affect all module mounts. The backend enforces a single metamodule. Status below describes installed files; reboot and device checks are needed to confirm effective mounts. A module with no system mount request can still mount files in its own scripts. Filesystem statistics are captured before metamodule mounting and updated in post-mount.
